title: Optimize Web Font Loading: Master CSS 'font-display' for Superior UI & UX
tweet: Boost your UI's perceived performance and enhance user experience by mastering CSS 'font-display'. Say goodbye to FOUC & FOIT! #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #UX
tip: Employ 'font-display: swap;' for most web fonts to prioritize content readability quickly, then swap in your custom font. For critical brand fonts, consider 'block' or 'fallback' with careful testing to manage layout shifts.
